title: PH, New Zealand reaffirm longstanding relations at APEC summit

blocks.text: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. talks to New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon as First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos looks on on the sidelines of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China. Photo from Presidential Communications Office

SHENZHEN, China — Philippine President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. and New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon have reaffirmed the longstanding friendship between their two countries on the sidelines of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting.
This developed in a pull aside meeting of the two leaders in Shenzhen amid the APEC summit.
Marcos and Luxon also expressed their shared commitment to continuing cooperation for the benefit of their peoples, according to the Presidential Communications Office.
Both the Philippines and New Zealand are member-economies of APEC. The host country for this year’s summit is China. — BAP, GMA News
